report.title: [RU] Призрачное состояние генератора после взрыва на грузовом конвейере. [EN] Generator 0‑HP ghost state after payload explosion.
report.body:
### Platforms

Windows

### Build

release build 159.7

### Issue

[RU] 
Генератор, заправленный взрывчатой смесью, может пережить собственный взрыв, если он стоит на грузовом конвейере. В результате появляется генератор с 0 HP, который неуязвим, продолжает работать и ломает ИИ юнитов, пытающихся с ним взаимодействовать. При перезаходе на сохранение, генератор теряет забагованные свойства, и становится просто блоком с 0 хп.
Демонстрация бага и его воспроизведения будет прикреплена в виде записи экрана (Простите за плохое качество и фреймрейт, мой ноутбук лучше не запишет)

[EN (DeepSeek translate)]
A generator can survive its own explosion if it is placed on a payload conveyor while fueled with Blast Compound. The resulting block has 0 HP, is indestructible, still functions, and can break enemy AI pathfinding. After reloading the save, the generator loses its bugged properties and becomes a normal block with 0 HP.
A video demonstration of the bug and its reproduction is included as a screen recording.
Please excuse the low resolution and framerate — my laptop is not capable of capturing higher quality footage.

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Ikw9oJ3dS4ffMi4ViG005SJQR1KysG-m/view?usp=sharing

### Steps to reproduce

[RU]
- Поставьте ГВС/Паровой генератор, и запитайте его взрывчатой смесью;
- Дайте ему повредиться, и подхватите юнитом;
- Выгрузите генератор на грузовой конвейер, и подождите до взрыва (Важно: "Взрывы реакторов" должны быть включены);
- Достаньте взорвавшийся генератор с конвейера юнитом, и установите его на землю.
Если у генератора пустая полоса здоровья, то баг удался. Ручную погрузку генератора можно заменить на грузовой загрузчик с Эрекира.

[EN (DeepSeek translate)]
- Place a Steam Generator (or Combustion generator) and fuel it with Blast Compound.
- Allow it to take damage, then pick it up using a unit.
- Unload the damaged generator onto a Payload Conveyor and wait for it to explode. (Important: Reactor explosions must be enabled in the game settings.)
- After it explodes, pick it up from the conveyor using a unit, and place it back on the ground.
If the generator has an empty health bar — the bug has successfully been triggered. Manual loading of the generator can be replaced with a payload loader from Erekir.

### Mods used

[RU]
Без модов

[EN]
No mods

### Save file

[RU]
Баг может быть воспроизведён на любом сохранении.

[EN (Google translater)]
The bug can be reproduced on any save.

### (Crash) logs

_No response_

summary: Could not execute the reported fueled-generator payload explosion. A local editor map was created and playtested; a Core Shard was added so the playtest launched, and the Steam Generator was identified and selected. However, the intended infinite-resources rule was not effective in the launched playtest (the placed generator remained a construction ghost due to missing lead/graphite/silicon). Consequently I could not construct, fuel, damage, transport, explode, retrieve, place, or reload the target block.

spec.summary: Reported: a damaged Steam Generator or Combustion Generator fueled with Blast Compound can allegedly remain as a 0-HP, functioning payload after exploding on a Payload Conveyor, then be placed back into the world with abnormal properties. Reporter states that reloading removes the abnormal properties while leaving the block at 0 HP.
spec.bug_class: Reported entity/block lifecycle or state-persistence anomaly involving payload transport and explosion
spec.observed_behavior: According to the report, after a fueled and damaged generator explodes while on a Payload Conveyor, the exploded generator can be picked up as a payload and placed on the ground. The placed generator is described as having an empty/0-HP health bar, being invulnerable, continuing to operate, and affecting AI units attempting to interact with it. The reporter further states that, after reloading the save, it becomes a normal block with 0 HP and loses the reported abnormal properties.
known_preconditions: Target commit supplied with report: ec656a63eb6c063fd35abbd7e65cb3b5dba1078b.
A Steam Generator or Combustion Generator is used.
The generator is fueled with Blast Compound.
The generator is damaged before being picked up.
The generator is placed onto a Payload Conveyor, either manually by a unit or reportedly via an Erekir payload loader.
The report says the 'Reactor explosions' setting must be enabled.
The report states that the behavior can occur on any save.
uncertain_conditions: The report does not establish whether both Steam Generator and Combustion Generator reproduce the same behavior, or whether one was actually tested.
The exact game mode, map, ruleset, campaign/sector status, and save state are not specified.
The exact health value/range required before transport and explosion is not specified.
It is unclear whether the generator must be actively generating power at the moment of explosion.
It is unclear whether Blast Compound must be present in a particular quantity, whether it must be continuously supplied, or whether other explosive fuels behave similarly.
The reported setting name and scope ('Reactor explosions') should be verified against the relevant build and rules configuration.
The exact payload conveyor arrangement, conveyor direction, surrounding blocks, and whether the payload is moving at explosion time are unspecified.
The report uses translated English text; terminology such as 'break enemy AI pathfinding' may not precisely describe the observed AI behavior.
The claim that the 0-HP generator is invulnerable, functional, and disrupts AI is unverified without the referenced recording or a reproducible test.
The reload outcome is described but the exact reload sequence is not specified (e.g., save/quit, restart, host reload, or multiplayer reconnect).
No Linux result is provided; Linux is listed only as planned evaluation.
Build version is absent from the structured field, and it is not confirmed that the supplied commit exactly corresponds to the reporter's release build.
reproduction_hints: Start from a controlled unmodded Windows environment matching the reported release build/commit where possible.
Enable the relevant reactor-explosion setting before testing.
Place a Steam Generator and separately test a Combustion Generator.
Fuel the generator with Blast Compound, damage it without destroying it, and pick it up with a unit.
Place the payload on a Payload Conveyor and allow the reported explosion to occur.
Attempt to pick up any remaining payload/block with a unit and place it on terrain.
Record the placed block's health display, destruction response, power-generation behavior, interaction behavior, and unit AI behavior.
Repeat using an Erekir payload loader in place of manual payload placement.
Save and reload after observing the state, then compare health, functionality, damage response, and AI interaction before versus after reload.
required_artifacts: The referenced screen recording, or an accessible downloadable copy; the supplied Google Drive link has not been independently reviewed.
A minimal save file containing the setup immediately before the generator is damaged or loaded onto the conveyor.
Exact build identifier/version and confirmation of the executable's relationship to target commit ec656a63eb6c063fd35abbd7e65cb3b5dba1078b.
Game settings/rules screenshots or configuration showing the reactor-explosion option enabled.
A screenshot or video of the generator before explosion, immediately after explosion while on the conveyor, after placement on the ground, and after reload.
Logs from a reproduction session, if available, including client/server logs for multiplayer cases.
Map name/seed or custom map file, game mode, and whether the test is single-player or multiplayer.
A concise description or capture of the alleged AI failure: affected unit type/team, intended interaction, and observed behavior.
If available, a save file captured after the 0-HP state is observed and another after reload.

hypotheses.statement: A damaged Blast-Compound-fueled generator can explode as a payload and remain retrievable as a zero-health block.
hypotheses.prediction: After placing the damaged fueled generator on a payload conveyor, an explosion leaves a payload/block that can be picked up and placed with an empty health bar.
hypotheses.observation: I reached a local editor playtest and identified/placed the Steam Generator build ghost, but the configured test did not supply the required materials or a working payload/fuel arrangement; therefore no explosion or post-explosion state was observed.
